text: Objective 7 progress bar text is clipped on the left: shows 'nbers 5/10 · Buildings 0/2' instead of 'Members 5/10 · Buildings 0/2' (objective box too narrow)

GOOD: in winter the HUD shows an amber line 'Yellowton: 1 member hungry. Bring food home and Feed Residents.' and a 'Feed Residents (1 hungry)' button appears inside the settlement while I carry apples

Feed Residents confirmation 'You fed 2 residents in the Village of Yellowton.' (tick 198480) was overwritten 20 ticks later by a diplomacy status 'Citywood shares an enemy with you...' so the player never sees feeding succeeded; only the apple count (42->40) tells. See shots/c4fed.png

While the 'Bandit camp' world event sheet covered the screen ('The world waits while you decide', tick frozen at 201552), H (Teleport home -> 'Welcome home!') and E ('Entered settlement.') still acted. Expected input to the world to be blocked while it waits. See shots/c6f.png

Settlement became a 'Town' (3+ buildings, 'House built. The settlement is now a Town!') yet the Era box still reads 'Camp (1/4)' and Objective 7 still says 'Reach the Village era' (Members 6/10). Settlement tier vs nation era is confusing when the town is already past village.

When the last hungry resident is fed, the 'Feed Residents (N hungry)' button vanishes and the pawn row reflows: 'Talk to Frank Robinson' slides into exactly the spot (297,414) where Feed was (compare shots/c10.png vs shots/fedagain.png). A second click on Feed then talks to a pawn instead (happened at tick 208124: Phoebe Thompson dialogue). Code comment says Feed was placed last 'so its coming and going moves nothing', but it does move the buttons.

Feed Residents hands each hungry pawn ONE item (apple = +15 energy; hungry threshold is 80). Fed 1 at tick 216844 and 217464, yet 'Yellowton: 1 member hungry' + 'Feed Residents (1 hungry)' are back by 217424 / 218548 (~600 ticks = 12 game seconds). While carrying 61 apples the leader has to stand in town clicking Feed every few game seconds; expected one press to feed a pawn back to full (or until no longer hungry).
